description_en: Provides question resolution services by using image URLs or Base64 encoding
description_zh: 通过图片URL或Base64编码提供题目解析服务
name: CreateEduProblemSolve

fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded image. If both this parameter and the URL are provided, this parameter takes precedence
fields.help_zh: 图片 base64；与 url 同时存在时优先使用
fields.name: base64

fields.help_en: The image format: jpg, jpeg, or png. The value must match the actual file format
fields.help_zh: 图片格式：jpg、jpeg、png，须与实际文件一致
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The URL of a single question image
fields.name: url

schema.description_en: The SSE event stream for a successful response
schema.description_zh: 成功响应的 SSE 事件流

finished.description_en: Specifies whether this is the final full snapshot. The value is fixed to true in the complete event
finished.description_zh: 是否为最终全量快照；complete 事件中固定为 true
finished.title_en: 是否为最终全量快照；complete 事件中固定为 true。
finished.title_zh: 是否为最终全量快照；complete 事件中固定为 true。

items.description_en: The current list of complete question results
items.description_zh: 当前完整题目结果列表

items.description_en: The details of the question item

content.description_en: The complete Markdown content of the question resolution, including the deduction process and the final result
content.description_zh: 完整 Markdown 解题内容，包含推导过程和最终结果
content.title_en: 完整 Markdown 解题内容，包含推导过程和最终结果。
content.title_zh: 完整 Markdown 解题内容，包含推导过程和最终结果。

imageUrl.description_en: The URL of the unique image for the current question. The URL may be time-sensitive. If the question is not associated with an image resource and no request URL is available for fallback, an empty string is returned
imageUrl.description_zh: 当前题目唯一图片的 URL，可能具有时效性；未关联到图片资源且无请求 URL 可回退时为空字符串
imageUrl.title_en: 当前题目唯一图片的 URL，可能具有时效性；未关联到图片资源且无请求 URL 可回退时为空字符串。
imageUrl.title_zh: 当前题目唯一图片的 URL，可能具有时效性；未关联到图片资源且无请求 URL 可回退时为空字符串。

questionId.description_en: The question identifier. The value is the question title, such as Question 1. The server does not return a separate title field. If the downstream service does not provide a question title, which is always the case for single-question scenarios, titles such as Question 1 and Question 2 are generated in the order of the questions
questionId.description_zh: 题目标识，取值为题目标题（如 题目1）；服务端不下发单独的标题字段。下游未提供题目标题时（单题场景恒如此），按题目顺序生成 题目1、题目2 等
questionId.title_en: 题目标识，取值为题目标题（如 题目1）；服务端不下发单独的标题字段。下游未提供题目标题时（单题场景恒如此），按题目顺序生成 题目1、题目2 等。
